referencePolicy: cave uses desktop concept for aesthetic only; remaining scenes use the generated clean cave painting as style reference, never an edit target

prompts.cave:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production environment painting for the Chinese cultivation game 尘缘问道; a single clean scene, landscape16:9, request high actual resolution3840x2160 if available.
Style: high-end semi-realistic Chinese fantasy game environment, confident hand-painted detail, convincing material texture and cinematic depth. Rich ink-jade/blue-green shadows with luminous mist and restrained warm amber light, beautiful natural contrast, no dull grey wash or plastic3D look. Chinese architecture and landscape, not European medieval fantasy. This should look substantially more attractive than a dim generic town backdrop.
Composition: scenic stage with a legible middle-distance focal point, interesting foreground framing and a deep background. Important subject survives a central desktop scene-card crop; naturally quieter dark bottom-left for a small DOM title, but do not paint a text box. The UI, characters and gameplay labels will be overlaid separately.
Constraints: no people, creatures, character portraits, letters, calligraphy, legible signs, writing on scrolls, UI, buttons, progress bars, borders, logos or watermark. No invented maps, modern objects or extra story beats. No open heaven gate in early scenes. Full-bleed environment only, no collage or multiple views.
Primary request: 听雨洞府, an intimate cultivator's cliffside cave retreat that feels like a real meditation/alchemy home, not a town panorama. Rain falls beyond the eaves; wet dark stone foreground, a clearly visible empty woven meditation mat, simple low wooden desk, small bronze alchemy furnace and amber lantern, bamboo and distant misty Chinese mountains with a few restrained rooflines. Warm interior against cool blue-green mountain air, light glancing over wet stone, tranquil but visually rich. Keep all books/scrolls blank. Reference image1 is aesthetic/context reference from the desktop concept only: extract the cave-retreat world and materials, omit every person, word, UI panel, emblem and button.
